question: AAI 50th All India Inter-Institutional Table Tennis Championships 2023 was organised by ___________.

options.text: Andhra Pradesh state table tennis association
Madhya Pradesh state table tennis association

solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh state table tennis association**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 50th All India Inter-Institutional Table Tennis Championships 2023 was **organized by the Andhra Pradesh state table tennis association**.
 
• This prestigious event took place in Andhra Pradesh and is recognized for fostering national-level table tennis talent.
 
• The championship is conducted under the aegis of the **Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI)**, the governing body for table tennis in India.
 
• The event provides a platform for institutional teams across India to showcase their skills and compete for the championship title.
 
• It serves as a critical milestone for athletes aiming to represent India in international table tennis tournaments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI):**

 
 
• TTFI is the apex body for table tennis in India, responsible for organizing national and international tournaments in the country.
 
• Founded in 1926, it is affiliated with the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF).
 
• TTFI works to promote the sport by organizing championships, training camps, and talent scouting programs.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Inter-Institutional Championships:**
 
 
• These tournaments bring together teams from various public and private institutions, fostering competitive spirit and skill enhancement.
 
• They also serve as a talent pool for identifying potential players for the national team.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh and Sports:**
 
 
• Andhra Pradesh has been actively involved in promoting sports, with a focus on creating world-class infrastructure and training facilities.
 
• The state has hosted several national and international sports events over the years.
 
 
 
• **History of Table Tennis in India:**
 
 
• Table tennis was introduced in India during the British era and has grown significantly in popularity since then.
 
• India has produced several notable players like Sharath Kamal, who have excelled in international competitions.
